newsitem.title: USA: Cronos Group names Peter Younger CFO.
newsitem.headline: Cronos Group names Peter Younger CFO.

text.p: Cronos Groups said Thursday that it had appointed Peter Younger as chief financial officer, succeeding Darrell Ponniah, effective today.

Cronos said Younger joined IEA, one of Cronos' predecessors, in 1987 as director of accounting and then vice president and controller based in San Francisco. It said he became vice president of finance in 1991.
The company did not immediately provide a reason for Ponniah's resignation.
